nativeValidation.setup: Use a non-elevated Windows PowerShell session in the repository root at the stated revision. Run commands 1 and 2, copy files.copyFrom to files.copyTo, then run the remaining commands in the same session. The probe uses a private scratch tree, holds a sharing-denied handle on its unreadable helper and cleans up its fixtures.
commands: if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne 'ae62733af2f34725bd166f9c2e1abe6f576e9e6e') { throw 'Unexpected validation revision' }
$env:CGO_ENABLED = '0'; $env:GOOS = 'windows'; $env:GOARCH = 'amd64'; go build -o (Join-Path $scratch 'agent.exe') ./cmds/ownsand-agent; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Agent build failed' }
go build -o (Join-Path $scratch 'windows-guest-amd64.exe') ./cmds/ownsand-guest; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows amd64 helper build failed' }
$env:GOARCH = 'arm64'; go build -o (Join-Path $scratch 'windows-guest-arm64.exe') ./cmds/ownsand-guest; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows arm64 helper build failed' }
$env:GOOS = 'darwin'; go build -o (Join-Path $scratch 'macos-guest-arm64') ./cmds/ownsand-guest; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'macOS arm64 helper build failed' }
$env:GOARCH = 'amd64'; go build -o (Join-Path $scratch 'macos-guest-amd64') ./cmds/ownsand-guest; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'macOS amd64 helper build failed' }

$env:GOOS = 'windows'; $env:OWNSAND_IMAGEBUILD_REAL_DARWIN_ARM64 = (Join-Path $scratch 'macos-guest-arm64'); $env:OWNSAND_IMAGEBUILD_REAL_WINDOWS_AMD64 = (Join-Path $scratch 'windows-guest-amd64.exe'); go test './cmds/ownsand-agent' './cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/imagebuild' '-count=1' '-v' '-run=^(TestImageBuildInputPreflight|TestImageBuildResourceRanges|TestBuildChecksTheGuestBinary|TestBuildRefusesWhileAnotherProcessBuilds|TestCheckRealCrossBuiltGuestHelpers)$' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $scratch 'windows-tests.log'); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows focused tests failed' }
expectedResults: Focused tests pass on Windows. The CLI probe prints “CLI matrix passed. Rejected inputs preserved entries, contents and DACLs.”

Missing Windows ISO or explicit invalid executable format or architecture exits 2 on fresh, existing and file state paths. Missing or sharing-denied helper exits 1 and reports lookup or open errors. Valid helpers reach the expected store error on the file state path.
The absent path remains absent. The existing directory and child retain their SDDL and contents. The regular-file state marker stays unchanged.
privilegedUnperformed: Hyper-V provisioning, ISO mounting and protected state-store ACL setup require elevation and are outside the preflight acceptance. The test-owned directory DACL comparison requires no elevation.

additionalPlatform.setup: Use the arm64 macOS host with Go, the native compiler and Python 3. Run commands 1 and 2, copy files.copyFrom to files.copyTo, then run the remaining commands in the same shell. No administrator access is needed.
commands: set -eo pipefail; mkdir -p .t3-tmp/image-preflight; export TMPDIR="$PWD/.t3-tmp/image-preflight" GOTMPDIR="$PWD/.t3-tmp/image-preflight" COPYFILE_DISABLE=1

CGO_ENABLED=1 GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 OWNSAND_IMAGEBUILD_REAL_DARWIN_ARM64="$TMPDIR/macos-guest-arm64" OWNSAND_IMAGEBUILD_REAL_WINDOWS_AMD64="$TMPDIR/windows-guest-amd64.exe" go test ./cmds/ownsand-agent ./cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/imagebuild -count=1 -v -run '^(TestImageBuildInputPreflight|TestImageBuildResourceRanges|TestBuildChecksTheGuestBinary|TestBuildRefusesWhileAnotherProcessBuilds|TestCheckRealCrossBuiltGuestHelpers)$' 2>&1 | tee "$TMPDIR/macos-tests.log"
expectedResults: Focused tests pass with cgo enabled. The CLI probe prints “CLI matrix passed. Rejected inputs preserved entries, contents and POSIX mode.”
Exit codes and diagnostics match the Linux CLI matrix. The test-owned directory retains mode 0755 and its sentinel.
privilegedUnperformed: Virtualization.framework installation, IPSW use and macOS guest boot need extra privileges and assets and are outside the preflight acceptance.
